name: zion
description: Team-style software delivery for Claude Code: an orchestrated multi-agent crew for building features, a pointer-driven tech-debt and dependency-upgrade fixer, and the shared review rubric behind both.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Team-style feature delivery for Claude Code: a captain agent plans the work and delegates each step to backend, frontend, test, and design specialists behind hook-enforced guardrails, with a consolidated review gate before anything ships.

plugins.name: engineering-principles
plugins.description: The code-review rubric behind the Zion crew, as a standalone skill: YAGNI, KISS, DRY applied with judgment, small single-purpose units, clear naming, and minimal-scope diffs. Adds no commands, agents, or hooks.

plugins.name: keymaker
plugins.description: Pay down tech debt one verified fix at a time: point it at a suppression, a rule, or an outdated package, and it reports the blast radius before editing, fixes in gated batches, and commits each batch only once its acceptance gate passes.
